title: The Algorithmic Unconscious: Structural Mechanisms and Implicit Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparative analysis of tokenization fertility by measuring the average input token count and calculating token inflation ratios for parallel sentences across English, Modern Standard Arabic, and Maghrebi dialects (Darija and Arabizi) using multiple LLM tokenizers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral).

Qualitative analysis and review of safety alignment procedures, demonstrating how Western-centric moderation systems and toxicity detection models misclassify or over-filter dialectal content and non-Western cultural concepts due to a lack of contextual and linguistic representation.
